cover: A checklist for your first AI test set

slides.title: Start from real inputs
slides.body: Past support tickets, real documents, questions customers have asked. New feature? Write them with the people doing the job today.

slides.title: Cases to include
slides.body: Common questions as customers phrase them, typos included. Questions it should decline. Look-alike questions with different answers.

slides.title: Cases people forget
slides.body: Messages telling it to ignore its instructions. Every real mistake after launch, added so it can't come back unnoticed.

slides.title: Pick a grader for each case
slides.body: Category, number or fixed format: check in code. Open-ended reply: a different model with a written rubric. Judgment calls: a person.

slides.title: Before any change ships
slides.body: Run the full set and compare scores. A failed must-pass case blocks the change, whatever the overall score.

slides.title: After launch
slides.body: If customers start asking things your test set doesn't cover, old scores look fine while quality slips. Review real failures and add them.
